tools.name: dctl_system
tools.description: General system control and discovery. Use this to list open windows, find launchable apps, or start new processes. Returns JSON describing windows, apps, or execution status.

action.description: The system action to perform. 'launch' starts an app by name; 'open' opens a URL or file path; 'list-windows' shows all visible window titles and IDs.

target.description: The target app name (for launch) or URL/file path (for open). Optional for other actions.

tools.name: dctl_ui
tools.description: Native UI automation via the OS Accessibility Tree. Use this to inspect UI elements, click buttons, type into fields, or read text on the desktop. Locates elements using a boolean selector string (e.g. 'app:"Code" AND role:button').

action.description: The UI interaction to perform. 'tree' dumps the accessibility hierarchy; 'click' triggers a button; 'type' inserts text; 'describe' identifies what is at coordinates; 'clipboard' reads or writes the system clipboard.

selector.description: The dctl selector query to find the element (e.g., 'app:"Chrome" AND name:"Search"'). Required for click, type, focus, read, wait, element.

text.description: The text to type into the element (used with action='type'), or text to write to clipboard (used with action='clipboard' and clipboard_action='write').

button.description: Mouse button for click action. Use 'right' for context menu.

clipboard_action.description: Clipboard operation. 'read' returns current clipboard text; 'write' stores the text parameter.

combo.description: The key combination to press (e.g., 'ctrl+c', 'cmd+s'). Used with action='key'.

tools.name: dctl_browser
tools.description: Deep browser automation via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol). Use this for complex web tasks like automating Google Docs, switching tabs, or reading the DOM. This bypasses OS accessibility and interacts directly with the browser engine.

action.description: Browser action. 'start'/'stop' manage browser processes; 'sessions' lists named sessions; 'discover' finds existing debug-enabled browsers; 'snapshot' extracts structured page content; 'actions' lists clickable elements; 'act' combines actions+click+optional snapshot in one call.

target.description: The target tab/page ID or 'active'. Required for most actions except 'start', 'tabs', 'sessions', 'discover'.

text.description: Text to type into the browser element.

session.description: Named session for persistent browser state.

action_id.description: Action ID from 'actions' list, used with 'click-action'.

query.description: Search query to filter actions by label text.

operations_json.description: JSON array of operations for 'batch' action.

tools.name: dctl_office
tools.description: Semantic document and spreadsheet editing (Word/Excel/LibreOffice). Use this to read paragraphs, edit cells, append text, answer questions in forms, or replace content in documents without a GUI. Supports .docx and .xlsx files, and live LibreOffice control via UNO.

type.description: The document type or editor backend. 'word' for .docx, 'excel' for .xlsx, 'libreoffice' for live LibreOffice control.

action.description: The editing action. Word: inspect/read/paragraphs/append/insert-before/set-paragraph/replace/backup/diff/worksheet-map/answer-question/answer-all/fill-table. Excel: inspect/sheets/read/write-cell/write-range/backup/diff/worksheet-map/locate-cell/fill-cell/fill-table. LibreOffice: lo-start/lo-stop/lo-docs/lo-open/lo-info/lo-save/lo-close/lo-writer-text/lo-writer-paragraphs/lo-writer-append/lo-writer-set/lo-calc-sheets/lo-calc-read/lo-calc-write-cell/lo-calc-write-range.

text.description: Text content to insert, append, or use as answer.

index.description: Paragraph index for insert-before or set-paragraph.

range.description: Cell range (e.g., 'A1:C3') for read or write-range.

value.description: Value to write to a cell.

find.description: Text to find for replace action.

against.description: Path to backup file for diff action.

answers_json.description: JSON array of {question, answer} objects for answer-all action.

entries_json.description: JSON array of fill entries for fill-table action.

table.description: Table name for fill-table/fill-cell when multiple tables exist.

document.description: Document name or path for LibreOffice actions.

rows_json.description: JSON array of row arrays for write-range.
